description: This PHP source file defines classes and constants related to parsing Smarty internal configuration files. It includes a lexer, parser logic with an internal stack, and methods for processing configuration variables, sections, and different token types, indicating it is part of the Smarty template engine's configuration parsing subsystem.

classes.name: TPC_yyStackEntry
classes.description: Represents a stack entry in the parser with state number, major token value, and minor token value.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Configfileparser
classes.description: The main internal plugin config file parser generated from a Yacc-like grammar, responsible for parsing and processing configuration files, maintaining parser state, and handling various token types and parsing rules.

methods.name: yy_destructor
methods.description: Destructor for parser tokens, currently no specific destruction logic implemented.

methods.name: parse_single_quoted_string
methods.description: Removes outer quotes and unescapes inner quotes from a single-quoted string token.

methods.name: parse_double_quoted_string
methods.description: Removes outer quotes and interprets escape sequences within a double-quoted string token.

methods.name: parse_tripple_double_quoted_string
methods.description: Processes triple quoted string tokens, unescaping escape sequences.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Sets tracing files and prompts for parser debugging.

methods.name: PrintTrace
methods.description: Initializes tracing output to standard output.

methods.name: tokenName
methods.description: Returns human-readable token name for given token type.

methods.name: yy_pop_parser_stack
methods.description: Pops the top element from the parser's internal stack, invoking destructor if needed.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up parser stack and tracing resources upon object destruction.

methods.name: yy_get_expected_tokens
methods.description: Returns expected tokens given the current parser stack state.

methods.name: yy_is_expected_token
methods.description: Checks if a token is expected in the current parser state.

methods.name: yy_find_shift_action
methods.description: Determines parser shift action based on current state and lookahead token.

methods.name: yy_find_reduce_action
methods.description: Finds parser reduce action for given state and lookahead.

methods.name: yy_shift
methods.description: Performs a shift to a new parser state, updating stack accordingly.

methods.name: yy_r0
methods.description: Rule action for produce empty configuration data.

methods.name: yy_r1
methods.description: Adds global variables to configuration data.

methods.name: yy_r4
methods.description: Adds variables to a section in the configuration.

methods.name: yy_r5
methods.description: Adds variables to a section if hidden read is enabled.

methods.name: yy_r6
methods.description: Returns the value token for further processing.

methods.name: yy_r7
methods.description: Merges list of variables.

methods.name: yy_r8
methods.description: Returns an empty array for no variables.

methods.name: yy_r9
methods.description: Creates a key-value pair for configuration variable.

methods.name: yy_r10
methods.description: Casts value token to float.

methods.name: yy_r11
methods.description: Casts value token to int.

methods.name: yy_r12
methods.description: Parses value token as boolean.

methods.name: yy_r13
methods.description: Parses single-quoted string token.

methods.name: yy_r14
methods.description: Parses double-quoted string token.

methods.name: yy_r15
methods.description: Parses triple double-quoted string token.

methods.name: yy_r16
methods.description: Returns empty string for undefined string token.

methods.name: yy_r17
methods.description: Returns the string value token.

methods.name: yy_reduce
methods.description: Performs a reduction step based on rule number, invoking appropriate rule action.

methods.name: yy_parse_failed
methods.description: Handles parse failure and cleans up parser stack.

methods.name: yy_syntax_error
methods.description: Handles syntax errors by setting internal error flag and triggering error handling.

methods.name: yy_accept
methods.description: Handles successful parse acceptance and cleanup.

methods.name: doParse
methods.description: Main parsing loop, processes tokens to build internal configuration data, handling shifts, reduces, errors, and acceptance.

methods.name: parse_bool
methods.description: Utility to parse boolean string tokens into boolean values.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets a variable in a target array, merging if overwrite is disabled.

methods.name: add_global_vars
methods.description: Adds a list of variables to the global config data.

methods.name: add_section_vars
methods.description: Adds variables to a specific section in the config data.
